answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the velvet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on succinct non-interactive computational proofs attesting to execution honesty. Written in a game-theoretic deductions, structured causal flow with definitive takeaways register, it stays short. The vine holds work receipts rather than names, so the mesa of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
